policy.overlap: First observed data wins; compare buffered bytes, report identical/conflicting overlaps, never rewrite committed frontier. UnverifiablePast includes late bytes for committed gaps and has no unbounded payload history. Separate incomplete/ambiguous closure indicators.
policy.sequence: Checked unwrapped64-bit coordinates with32-bit serial arithmetic; SYN/FIN consume numbers, half-space/window bounds enforced. Unknown prefix and tuple-reuse boundary explicit; ACK/sequence evidence separated from declared payload extent for FIN validation.
policy.loss: Missing bytes remain recoverable until deadline/closure. Permanent Gap precedes later Data, no zero fill or concatenation through loss. Pressure rejects new queued holes before copying and retains extent; deterministic LRU capacity boundary flushes. In-order data bypasses pending storage.
policy.output: Returned data<=previous queued bytes+one bounded input; event count<=2*total_chunks+8*flows+2*direction_chunks+32. Fixed keys and bounded nodes/hole lists/event capacity bound metadata separately. Caller must consume/move results through its own bounded channel.
policy.clock: Caller monotonic processing time, no source/device timestamp or wall-clock dependency; timers precede input at the same timestamp, gap timer not refreshed while hole remains. Backward time rejected.
